commit.message:
feat(auto-scaling, webapp, deployment): add auto-scaling, batch prediction, caching, and production configs (#36)

- Introduce AutoScaler class with metrics collection, scaling logic, and monitoring
- Add batch prediction endpoint with input validation and caching for performance
- Implement thread-safe LRU cache for prediction results in webapp
- Enhance webapp with system metrics collection and auto-scaling integration
- Add health and scaling status endpoints for monitoring
- Provide production-ready deployment configs for Docker Compose and Kubernetes
- Add Nginx config with load balancing, rate limiting, and security headers
- Include deployment script for Docker and Kubernetes with health checks and rollback
- Add comprehensive tests for auto-scaling and batch prediction features
- Update preprocessing, schemas, and training modules to support new features
- Add final report documenting autonomous SDLC completion and achievements

This commit delivers a production-grade, scalable, and secure sentiment analysis platform with advanced deployment and operational capabilities.
